offering_description.value: Owns and operates ethylene production facilities in Lake Charles, Louisiana and Calvert City, Kentucky, plus an ethylene pipeline. Sells ethylene and co-products to Westlake Corporation under long-term fee-based agreements.

customer_segment.value: B2B: Westlake Corporation, its general partner's parent, buys nearly all ethylene output under long-term agreements

end_markets.value: petrochemicals; plastics; PVC and polyethylene; building products

revenue_model.value: product sales: ethylene sold to Westlake under cost-plus, fixed-margin ethylene sales agreements

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces ethylene from purchased ethane and feedstock, sold to Westlake for downstream derivatives; asset operator: operates ethylene crackers and an ethylene pipeline

geography_served.value: US regional: Louisiana and Kentucky plants, Gulf Coast and Ohio River Valley

specialization.value: niche specialist: ethylene production and related pipeline

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: ethylene sold directly to Westlake, by pipeline and on-site

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental, process safety and pipeline rules from EPA, OSHA and PHMSA
